name: resizable
title: Resizable
description: Panels separated by handles you drag or move with the keyboard.
a11y: Each handle is a focusable role="separator" with aria-orientation, aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-controls pointing at the panel it resizes.
Arrow keys resize by the step (horizontal groups use Left/Right, vertical groups Up/Down; mirrored in right-to-left); PageUp/PageDown resize by double; Home and End jump to the limits.
minSize and maxSize are enforced for both keyboard and pointer, and are reflected in aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax.
Handles are at least 24 CSS px to grab and show the focus ring.

props.name: direction
props.description: `horizontal` puts panels side by side; `vertical` stacks them. Default `horizontal`.

props.name: step
props.description: Percent a panel grows or shrinks per arrow-key press (PageUp/PageDown use double). Default 5.

props.name: onLayoutChange
props.description: Called with every panel's size in percent (they add up to 100) after each resize.

props.name: children
props.description: `ResizablePanel` and `ResizableHandle` elements, alternating, as direct children: panel, handle, panel...

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Starting size in percent. Panels without one share what is left equally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the handle for screen readers. Default "Resize panels".

usage:
import {ResizableHandle, ResizablePanel, ResizablePanelGroup} from '@monoline/react'; const box = {padding: 'var(--s4)', fontSize: 'var(--text-sm)'};
